evidence.headline:
To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person
manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12 , 500 12,500 hours across
38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies.
evidence.idea:
To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person
manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12 , 500 12,500 hours across
38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies.
bullets:
The corpus
comprises 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes, collected at 6 sites.

The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth
maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and
object annotations.
evidence.summary:
To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person
manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12 , 500 12,500 hours across
38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies.
evidence.practice_takeaway:
Clock and calibration data are released
with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned.

self_report_as_fact.why: Preprint by authors, not a company claim about itself.
